{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
# First, check if any patient_id appears more than once
print('Patient_id duplicates:', df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum())

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Now check: how many rows after dedup?
print('Rows after dedup:', len(df_dedup))"}
